campaign_description: A standalone adventure to stop a mad alchemist's dangerous experiments.

alchemist_research_notes.name: Archibald's Research Notes
alchemist_research_notes.description: A thick leather-bound journal filled with cramped, increasingly erratic handwriting. The early pages contain legitimate alchemical formulae, but as you progress, the notes become more disturbing. Archibald writes of 'unlocking the secrets of life and death' and 'bridging the gap between the living and the dead.' Diagrams show experiments combining alchemical compounds with necromantic symbols. The final pages contain a formula for a 'volatile compound' that he claims can 'animate the deceased.'

volatile_compound.name: Volatile Compound
volatile_compound.description: A bubbling vial of sickly green liquid that seems to glow faintly in the dark. The compound is warm to the touch and occasionally releases small puffs of vapor. According to Archibald's notes, this experimental mixture was intended to animate dead tissue. Handle with extreme care.

necromantic_evidence.name: Necromantic Ritual Components
necromantic_evidence.description: A collection of disturbing items found in the specimen chamber: a ritual dagger inscribed with death runes, vials of preserved blood, fragments of bone arranged in arcane patterns, and a tattered page from a forbidden necromantic tome. Together, these items prove beyond doubt that Archibald was practicing forbidden death magic.

preserved_specimen.name: Preserved Alchemical Specimen
preserved_specimen.description: A sealed glass jar containing a small creature preserved in murky alchemical fluid. The creature appears to be a strange hybrid - part rat, part something else entirely. It floats motionless in the liquid, yet you could swear its tiny eyes follow you. The jar is labeled 'Specimen 17 - Partial Success' in Archibald's handwriting.

quests.name: The Mad Alchemist
quests.description: Master Aldric, the village apothecary, is gravely concerned. His former apprentice, Archibald, has gone mad and taken over an abandoned laboratory outside town. Strange fumes and explosions have been seen at all hours. Someone must stop him before his experiments harm the village.

available.apothecary: My former apprentice Archibald... he was always brilliant but unstable. Now he's taken over the old Thornwood Laboratory outside town. The fumes and explosions - it's dangerous! Someone must stop him before he poisons the whole village.
available.mayor: That laboratory on the hill has been belching toxic smoke for days. Master Aldric says his old apprentice has gone mad. We need adventurers brave enough to put a stop to this menace.

npc_hints.active: Be careful in that laboratory! Archibald's experiments are deadly. Find his research notes if you can - I need to understand what he was trying to do.
npc_hints.completed: You stopped Archibald? Thank the gods! Let me see those research notes... this is troubling indeed.

quests.name: Dangerous Knowledge
quests.description: Master Aldric has examined the research notes and discovered that Archibald was working on a formula to synthesize a powerful toxin. A sample of the volatile compound must be delivered to the village healer for analysis to ensure no one was poisoned.

objectives.description: Deliver the volatile compound sample to Healer Gwendolyn

npc_hints.available: This compound in Archibald's notes... it's dangerous. Take this sample to Healer Gwendolyn. She'll know if anyone in town has been exposed.
npc_hints.active: Have you delivered the sample to Gwendolyn yet? Time is of the essence!
npc_hints.completed: Good work getting that sample analyzed. At least we know the village is safe.

quests.name: The Specimen Chamber
quests.description: Healer Gwendolyn's analysis revealed traces of necromantic energy in the compound. She believes Archibald may have been experimenting on the dead. Return to the laboratory and investigate the locked specimen chamber for evidence of his dark experiments.

objectives.description: Find evidence of Archibald's dark experiments

bonus_rewards.description: Return the preserved specimen to Healer Gwendolyn for study

available.healer: The compound has necromantic traces! Archibald was experimenting with death itself. The laboratory has a locked specimen chamber - investigate it for evidence. Be careful, his experiments may still be active.
available.apothecary: Gwendolyn told me about the necromantic traces. I never taught Archibald such dark arts! Please, find evidence of what he was really doing in that laboratory.

npc_hints.active: The specimen chamber holds the key. Watch out for any animated experiments - Archibald's magic may still linger.
npc_hints.completed: This evidence is damning. Archibald was indeed dabbling in necromancy. At least his madness has been stopped. Thank you, brave adventurer.
